answer: LINE(2nd) emphasizes second-order proximity: it tries to preserve similarity in nodes’ neighborhood distributions, so two nodes are close if they have similar neighbors even if they are not directly connected. node2vec, by contrast, learns embeddings from biased random walks and captures a mix of local neighborhood structure and broader structural context, balancing breadth-first and depth-first exploration. In the reported comparison, node2vec achieves the better overall word analogy score.
